findings.interpretation: Sysmon EventID:11 recorded the creation of LSASS process memory dump files on PC04.example.corp. Target file 'lsass.exe_190317_120941.dmp' on Desktop was generated by procdump.exe. LSASS memory dumps expose plaintext credentials, Kerberos ticket-granting tickets (TGTs), and NTLM hashes.
findings.benign_explanation: Legitimate diagnostic dump by software engineer troubleshooting system crash, or antivirus agent scanning process memory.
findings.limitation: No network egress logs available to verify whether extracted credentials were sent to C2. | Analysis constrained to standalone public EVTX sample from PC04.example.corp.
findings.next_step: Search disk for *.dmp and *.hdmp files in %TEMP% and user Desktop. | Audit domain controller authentication logs (EventID:4624/4768) for anomalous logon attempts using compromised credentials.
